game: Resident Evil: Operation Raccoon City (2012), PC and Xbox Completion Route
target: Spoiler-free total completion: both campaigns, every collectible and gallery unlock, all ranks, weapons, abilities, roster slots, modes, maps, shipped add-ons, and Xbox-exclusive content

areas.name: Route and Access
areas.location_cue: The PC library, Xbox backward-compatible installation, profile screen, and add-on manager.
areas.note: The native PC run remains primary; Xbox is an additional required pass for exclusive shipped content.

levels.1: Confirm the native copy can reach its main menu before planning the run.
levels.2: Install the Windows release from the already-owned PC library entry.
levels.3: The PC listing is no longer a dependable new-purchase route. Install from an existing entitlement, apply only the minimum compatibility steps needed for Games for Windows Live, and verify that a local profile saves campaign progress before continuing.

levels.1: A short menu check now prevents an unusable completion record later.
levels.2: Finish the opening checkpoint, return to the menu, and reload the profile.
levels.3: Create or select the intended local profile, finish one checkpoint, quit normally, relaunch the game, and confirm that mission access, XP, and settings remain. Preserve the working profile folder before changing compatibility components.

levels.1: One shipped mode requires the console edition as a second route.
levels.2: Use the Xbox 360 release through Xbox One or Xbox Series backward compatibility.
levels.3: Install the backward-compatible Xbox build and its owned add-ons, then verify online sign-in. This secondary pass is required for the console-exclusive multiplayer mode; the Windows save cannot substitute for it.

levels.1: Check every owned add-on before entering either campaign menu.
levels.2: Confirm both Echo expansions, all weapon packs, the uniform pack, and the Xbox-only mode are installed where applicable.
levels.3: Open each platform's manage-game screen and compare installed content with the add-on ledger later in this pack. Do not repurchase blindly: preserve existing licenses, capture the installed list, and launch once while signed in so the game recognizes each entitlement.

levels.1: Public population is too uncertain for a completion schedule.
levels.2: Prepare enough invited players to start every Versus mode privately.
levels.3: Use private invitations and agree on role rotations before starting. Keep the same host for a planned block, finish every match at its normal results screen, and confirm counters advance before attempting long cumulative challenges.

save_backup.title: Preserve working profiles and licenses
save_backup.why: The PC dependency and old online entitlements can be difficult to reconstruct.
save_backup.detail: Copy the working PC profile and capture both platforms' installed-add-on lists before changing components or starting online progression.

areas.name: Campaign Systems and Difficulty
areas.location_cue: The campaign selector, difficulty prompt, loadout screen, and post-mission results.
areas.note: Progress persists across replay; lower settings are retained as separate option checks even when they gate no unique reward.

levels.1: Use the first safe combat space to test the full control set.
levels.2: Complete the tutorial prompts and test movement, aiming, melee, dodge, healing, grenades, and ability activation.
levels.3: Finish every prompted control, then deliberately use one primary weapon, one sidearm, one grenade, one melee string, one dodge, one healing item, and the equipped active ability. Confirm the pause-menu control page has no untested action.

levels.1: The AI-assisted route has its own practical completion record.

levels.1: A full squad exposes the cooperative version of the campaign systems.

levels.1: Collectibles, grades, and multiplayer results all feed one upgrade budget.

areas.name: Final Completion Audit
areas.location_cue: Mission select, Extras, Statistics, loadouts, add-on managers, and both platform profiles.
areas.note: Run this after all preceding entries are complete or explicitly preserved as an access limitation.

levels.1: Mission select reveals missing clears, grades, and pickup totals.
levels.2: Confirm every primary and Echo mission tile has a saved clear and every primary tile has S+.
levels.3: Inspect both campaign selectors, verify all installed tiles are complete on every selected difficulty, and confirm S+ on all primary missions. Revisit only the tile whose result, Intel, camera, mascot, or typewriter record is incomplete.

levels.1: The profile and Extras menus consolidate the permanent pickup records.
levels.2: Confirm 329 Intel route entries, 115 cameras, seven mascots, three typewriters, and 116 gallery drawings.
levels.3: Compare every mission's ordered Intel and camera entries with its result tally, verify all mascot and typewriter one-time XP records, then open every numbered Gallery panel. Upload any stranded Intel before declaring the drawing grid complete.

levels.1: Two loadout menus account for nearly all persistent XP spending.
levels.2: Confirm every standard weapon is purchased and all ninety class-ability levels are filled.
levels.3: Inspect each weapon category for locked XP rows, then open all six class grids and verify five abilities with three filled levels apiece. Equip every active ability and every usable weapon at least once, including add-on and field-only tools.

levels.1: Numbered menu positions keep this check independent of identity spoilers.
levels.2: Confirm all twelve campaign slots, eight Heroes slots, eight standard Versus slots, and six alternate uniforms were used.
levels.3: Compare the numbered completion records against each selection grid. Repeat a short mission or match for any unrecorded slot, and equip each alternate uniform on its corresponding primary slot before the final profile capture.

levels.1: Mode, map, and lifetime records are split between two platform profiles.
levels.2: Confirm all four common Versus modes, every installed map tile, all mechanical challenges, and the Xbox-exclusive mode.
levels.3: Capture the Windows statistics and map grids, then capture the Xbox exclusive-mode entitlement, map rotation, and results. Keep platform records separate; do not mark the Xbox-only pass complete from a Windows screenshot.
